recognize_zh: 視野中央一顆比周圍紅血球大約兩倍的細胞，細胞核圓形、偏心且未分葉，染色質中度凝集；細胞質豐富，佈滿粗大顆粒，以粉橘紅色為主並夾雜少量偏紫色的未成熟顆粒；圓核加上嗜酸性顆粒，符合嗜酸性骨髓球（eosinophilic myelocyte）。
features: Large cell (about 2 red cell diameters) with abundant cytoplasm and moderate N:C ratio
Round, eccentric, non-indented and non-segmented nucleus with moderately condensed chromatin; no distinct nucleolus
Cytoplasm filled with coarse granules, predominantly pink-orange with admixed purplish (immature, basophilic-staining) eosinophil granules
Granules partly overlap the nucleus; no Auer rods
Surrounding red cells normocytic and normochromic
describe_en: Peripheral blood smear shows a large granulocytic precursor with a round, eccentric, non-segmented nucleus, moderately condensed chromatin without an evident nucleolus, and abundant cytoplasm packed with coarse pink-orange eosinophilic granules admixed with some darker purplish immature granules. Background red cells are normocytic and normochromic. The morphology is consistent with an eosinophilic myelocyte; its presence in blood suggests a left-shifted or myeloproliferative process and warrants correlation with the eosinophil count and CBC.

ddx.vs: Mature eosinophils have a bilobed nucleus with condensed chromatin and uniformly orange refractile granules, whereas this cell has a round non-segmented nucleus.
Basophilic granules are dark purple-black, water-soluble and obscure the nucleus, rather than predominantly pink-orange.

ddx.dx: Abnormal eosinophil precursors of AML with inv(16)/t(16;16)
ddx.vs: inv(16) eosinophils contain large, dark purple-violet abnormal granules predominating in early precursors within a blast-rich marrow, unlike this well-granulated myelocyte.
Neutrophilic myelocytes have fine lilac specific granules with a perinuclear Golgi zone rather than coarse orange eosinophilic granules.
